about_the_game:
Want to learn Blender but don't know where to start? START HERE!
BLENDER START HERE teaches the BASICS of Blender through play and storytelling while familiarizing complicated Blender actions with fun mini games and puzzles. LEARN TIPS AND TRICKS from Suzanne while fighting DUBE to free your friends!

Blender Start Here covers 7 topics:
Level 1 Orbit, Zoom
[TBD] View Selected
[TBD] Move, Rotate, Scale
[TBD] Delete, Add Objects
[TBD] Camera Render
[TBD] Object vs Edit Mode
[TBD] Vertices, Edges, Faces

We've also partnered with some of the BEST Blender Mentors and Creators to feature in our COLLECTABLE CREATOR CARDS found throughout the game. These cards will feature their work to help YOU decide where to continue your Blender journey after the game!

*Currently Requires PC & Mouse*
